import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    res = True
    while m > 0:
        if m % w == 0:
            m //= w
        elif m % w == 1:
            m //= w
        elif m % w == w - 1:
            m += 1
            m //= w
        else:
            res = False
            break
    
    print("YES" if res else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
